execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
movies <- read_csv("data/movies.csv")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
movies_clean <- movies |>
  separate_longer_delim(genre, delim = ", ")
```

```{r}
ggplot(movies, aes(x = tomatoMeter)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, na.rm = TRUE) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Tomatometer Scores",
    subtitle = paste(nrow(movies), "films"),
    x = "Tomatometer Score",
    y = "Count"
  )
```

```{r}
movies_gap <- movies_clean |>
  mutate(gap = tomatoMeter - audienceScore) |>
  filter(tomatoMeter != 0, audienceScore != 0)

movies_summary <- movies_gap |>
  group_by(genre) |>
  summarise(
    mean_gap = mean(gap, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  ) |>
  filter(n >= 100) |>
  arrange(desc(mean_gap))
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  movies_summary,
  aes(x = fct_reorder(genre, mean_gap), y = mean_gap)
) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Critics vs. Audiences by Genre",
    subtitle = "Genres with at least 100 films",
    x = "Genre",
    y = "Average Tomatometer minus audience score"
  )
```
